````text
# #3543: Patch: Stinkyscape+ E3, Flexible, Evasive and Frenzy
Opened by @squishy-squooby.

Part of fullsend 1 of the Stinkyscape+ set (#3534, tracker #3533). It builds **Flexible**, **Evasive** and **Frenzy**, and migrates the shipped cards: every Unit that can't be attacked gains Evasive, every "after this kills a Unit it may attack again" gains Frenzy, and every Flying Unit has Flexible innately.

The plan: [`docs/stinkyscape-plus-set.md`](https://github.com/jlore-studios/jackioh/blob/claude/laughing-wright-eaibe9/docs/stinkyscape-plus-set.md) (SP2, SP3, SP4, SP8, SP10); the designer's list: [`JackiOh_StinkyscapePlus_Cards.md`](https://github.com/jlore-studios/jackioh/blob/claude/laughing-wright-eaibe9/JackiOh_StinkyscapePlus_Cards.md). Both are on the planning branch `claude/laughing-wright-eaibe9` until the foundation (#3535) brings them onto this fullsend's branch. Where they disagree with SPEC, SPEC wins (CLAUDE.md). `{For AI: …}` notes in the designer's text are the designer's notes to you, the builder, not to the game's AI (SP5).

## The designer's words

```text
* **Flexible (New Keyword)**
  * Can be played in the unit row or the back row
* **Frenzy (New Keyword)**
  * **Frenzy** [effect]
  * **Frenzy** triggers the effect after the unit attacks and destroys a unit
  * So for example **Frenzy** can attack again would equate to **After this kills a unit it may attack again**
  * Give frenzy to all past cards with this effect
  * Nerfs can get rid of **Frenzy** keyword
  * Unit being buffed or gaining a random key word can gain the combat keyword **Frenzy** with “**Frenzy** this may attack again” and this
* **Evasive (New Keyword)**
  * Same thing as **Can’t be attacked**
  * Give all units with **Can’t be attacked** this
  * Units with **Evasive** implicitly have **Can’t Defend** (similar to indestructible)
  * A nerf can remove **Evasive**
```

The owner, 2026-11-09, on Flexible: "units in the backrow CAN attack & act as a normal unit. Think of it as flying units <-- innately have flexible".

## The build (change a default only with a ruling note)

- **Flexible** (the owner's call): "Can be played in the unit row or the back row." The player picks the row as they play it. A Unit in the backrow **can attack and acts as a normal Unit**, as a Flying Unit in the backrow already does: §6.1 Flying lets a Flying Unit be played into an empty backrow zone, where it is a Unit for every rule (R1081000; summons and "fill your board", R2248000). **Flying Units innately have Flexible.** Flexible is that placement made a keyword any card may have, and Flying grants it instead of carrying the rule itself. Flying Units behave exactly as before, so no shipped Flying card plays differently, and a test proves it. **Default:** a Flexible Field Spell may be played into a unit zone and keeps working there as a Field Spell; one with printed stats (#59 Mass Driver) is also a Unit there, which can be attacked and can attack. Write the ruling.
- **Evasive**: "Same thing as Can't be attacked … Units with Evasive implicitly have Can't Defend … A nerf can remove Evasive." It is a keyword. Every shipped card that says "Can't be attacked" gets Evasive instead (a catalog migration, since those cards gain Can't Defend). **Default:** a card that has both shows Evasive alone.
- **Frenzy [effect]**: "triggers the effect after the unit attacks and destroys a unit." "Frenzy: this may attack again" means "After this kills a unit it may attack again". Every shipped card with that effect gains the keyword. A Nerf can remove Frenzy, and the random-keyword pools (a Buff's, "gain a random keyword") gain "Frenzy: this may attack again" as a combat keyword.

## The cards that will use it

S07 and S08 (the Mindustrial turrets), S09 (#50 Graphite's Frenzy), S10 and S11 (Flexible field spells and #58 Phase Conveyer), every Flying Unit, and every shipped card the migration touches.

## The shipped cards

The migration changes how shipped cards play (Evasive brings Can't Defend, and the random-keyword pools change), so the release's pending fragment must claim them. Record the cards in `spec/pending/<this issue>.md` and in a table in the part's final comment: each card's id, name, old keywords and new ones. A card in BUILD's must-pass tables (M13 and before) gets its row updated.

## Done when

- [ ] The mechanic is written into the spec's sections it changes (§3, §4, §6 Flying and the new rows, §10), with ruling notes numbered in this issue's block, tests named after them, and the paragraph in `spec/pending/<this issue>.md` (CLAUDE.md rule 3).
- [ ] It is proved on fixture scripts in `crates/engine/tests/rules*` (the `testkit` feature's `scenario()`): a Flexible Unit played into the backrow attacks, is attacked and defends as a normal Unit, and a Flying Unit's placement is unchanged. The migrated shipped cards' own tests are updated in their script files.
- [ ] The view (`view_for`) and the wire carry what it shows (`docs/v0.3.0/SURFACE.md` for any boundary it adds; `cargo test … --features jackioh-engine/ts` rewrites `apps/web/src/wire/`), and the client offers both rows when a Flexible card is played, as it already does for Flying.
- [ ] Every prompt it opens is answered by the AI, the random policy and the timeout. Every number is a named constant in `crates/engine/src/config.rs` (rule 9). The engine stays pure (rule 4).
- [ ] `cargo test --workspace --features jackioh-engine/testkit,jackioh-engine/ts`, `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings`, `cargo jackioh catalog check`, `spec check`, `golden check` and `fuzz --seeds 200` pass.

Blocked by #3540

Part of #3534.
````

# Draft plan, issue #3543 (E3: Flexible, Evasive, Frenzy) — planner's notes

## Found so far
- Keyword::Flexible/Frenzy/Evasive + KeywordKind declared by foundation (#3535) in crates/engine/src/wire/catalog_types.rs (~L716-724, 785-795), "R3535002: declared for SP3 E3; no rule yet". AI's features.rs lists them in UNCOUNTED_KEYWORDS (keep).
- BASE IS RED on `spec check`: 249 problems, all R3535000/R3535002 with no note (foundation's notes missing on this branch). Builder must add no new problem; report it.
- Flying backrow placement: play_choices.rs `flies()` (L390), `flying_takes_backrow`, `legal_zones_for` (L589), `default_zone_for` (L650), L2549; summon.rs `flies` (R2248000, ~L233); attack_summon.rs L143/185.
- Evasive = restrictions.rs `cannot_be_attacked` (L180) + implied Can't Defend: copy Indestructible's R2179000 sites: combat.rs `why_cannot_switch_in` (L278-287), state_check.rs `leave_defense` (L175-200).
- Shipped cards to migrate: classicplus-051 J15 Fighter (StaticFlags cant_be_attacked in c051 script; already Can't Defend → shows Evasive alone); stinkyscape-094 Tmack Trav ("After this destroys a Unit, it may attack again"). Classic Golem C+ #73.1 ("If it dies, this may attack again" on a transform) — decide. Corpse Eater #89 is "after this attacks a Unit" → NOT Frenzy.
- RANDOM_KEYWORD_POOL in config.rs L296 (const &[&str]); many tests pin it.
- patches check: changing a shipped catalog entry needs a pending fragment (crates/cards/patches/pending/), else red.
- Mass Driver (S+ #59) catalog has no stats yet (S10 adds 0/6); Mender (#40) is stat-less Field Spell. R2280000: a card with no stats never becomes a Unit. card_type_of: anything in Row::Units is a Unit.

## Decisions so far
- Frenzy (bare keyword) = engine rule mirroring Tmack Trav's after_attack: attacker survived (on the stay it attacked from, R2285001), target is a Unit in combat.destroyed_ids -> may_attack_again {target self, keepSick true}. No generic "Frenzy: [effect]" hook (no card needs it; YAGNI).
- Migrate: stinkyscape-094 Tmack Trav, classicplus-073-1 Classic Golem (its after_attack is identical: target in destroyed_ids -> refresh, default keeps sick), classicplus-051 J15 Fighter (Evasive replaces Can't Defend + "Can't be attacked.").
- NOT migrated: core-089 Corpse Eater ("after this attacks a Unit" - no kill), Bot Loser C+#19.5 / Ravager TG#9 / CN Golem M#95.1 (kill riders other than attack again) -> Open question.
- R767000: new scripts drop the flag/hook; old scripts kept in crates/cards/src/history.rs KEPT_SCRIPTS under "v0.5.13g" (newest shipped, patches.json) as script_v0_5_13g. Existing kept entries: J15 v0.5.9f, Golem v0.5.9f, Tmack v0.5.7 (script_v0_5_11). covering() picks smallest kept version >= replay's.
- Catalog change to shipped cards -> pending fragment needed for `patches check` (crates/cards/patches/pending/*.json via `cargo jackioh patches "<title>"`, fill player note by hand).
- Golden hotseat decks: core cards only, incl core-089 (unchanged). Pool change probably doesn't touch it; builder runs golden check.
- Agent 1 (placement survey) results: placement by Flying at play_choices.rs `flies` :392 (used by legal_zones_for :590, default_zone_for :664, refuse_zone :2551), summon.rs `summon_flies` :235 (callers summon_lands, summon_fresh, summon_existing, summon_copy, fill_board, summon_random_from_hand), summon.rs :757-767 summon_random (printed keywords Flying), anomaly.rs :215 prints_flying, testkit/scenario.rs :908. No stored "standing" mark: zones.rs:1583 is_standing_unit = position.is_some() && Unit. play_steps.rs:1624 places Backrow via place_standing_on_field, else place_on_field (place_with accepts any card in Row::Units, sets Atk). AI/random/web read zones from legal_actions only -> no client change for placement. Glossary: crates/shared/data/glossary.json (+ Chinese in crates/cards/chinese-terms.json "glossary" and "keywords"). Layer model for granted keywords: layers.rs:514 (Starship tag -> Flying, Ranged) — NOT used (would change every Flying card's view → classify diff).
- Rulings planned: R3543000 Flexible Unit placement (Flying innately, Units only, shown as Flying alone); R3543001 Flexible Field Spell (with stats → unit zone as Unit; stat-less → backrow only, changes SP3 default); R3543002 Evasive; R3543003 Frenzy; R3543004 Frenzy joins combat keyword pool last.
- Chinese: chinese.json entries for the 3 migrated cards; chinese-terms.json keywords+glossary for Flexible 灵活 / Evasive 闪避 / Frenzy 暴怒.

## More facts (after agents 2,3)
- BASE RED too: `cargo test -p jackioh-cards --test cards r1303_the_terms_name_every` (chinese-terms.json tags lack Automa-*/Mindustrial/Mineral/Paperclip; keywords lack the 8 R3535002 kinds). Web typecheck likely red: KEYWORD_MARK, KEYWORD_VISUALS, cards/KeywordFx.tsx DRAW, ChineseTerms are Record<KeywordKind> and generated KeywordKind has the 8 new kinds. No node_modules here. Client keyword visuals left to S26.
- Frenzy engine site: combat.rs close_combat :2148 -> combatant_hooks :2199. destroyed_ids from Destroyed{killer_id==attacker} since `from`; survived = is_active_on_field && !stays::left_field_after(since). Fuzz monitor testkit/invariants.rs ~:2597 credits kill only if script.after_attack -> add Frenzy.
- buff.rs POOL_KEYWORDS :36-51 needs ("Frenzy", Keyword::Frenzy). Exact pool tests: tests/rules/config.rs:50-68, rulings_config.rs:50-76 (+len 14), rulings_a.rs:1456-1474, effects_buff.rs:695. Pool text also in BUILD.md:148, §6.1 :68/:70, R0021.md:10, glossary.json "Combat keyword", chinese-terms glossary "Combat keyword", apps/web/src/game/modeText.ts:298.
- Chinese faces live in crates/cards/card-text.yaml (zh); chinese.json regenerated by `cargo test -p jackioh-tools --test export_card_text`.
- R366 card-text test: first line lists every printed keyword label -> "Rush, Frenzy".
- BUILD rows :936 (C+51), :964 (C+73.1), :1296 (S94). §8 rows 08-catalog.md :334, :362, :679.
- web B11 (rules.test.ts:546): every §6.1 row = glossary term or RULES_ONLY_ROWS -> glossary entries needed for Flexible/Evasive/Frenzy.
- AI evaluate.rs has_attack_hook :363 (R2688000) – Tmack loses after_attack -> price 0 (risk, accepted).
- J15 script_v0_5_9f = never_defense_kept(script(),..) -> must become never_defense_kept(script_v0_5_13g(),..).
